subject.title: Control UI chat history hardcoded to 100 messages, no load more pagination

question: Should this issue close with a larger fixed Control UI history batch, or should closure require an older-message pagination affordance backed by `chat.history` offsets?
rationale: Current source proves both the 100-message UI cap and an offset-capable backend, but the docs describe bounded recent history for stability, so maintainers need to own the UX/performance tradeoff.

options.title: Require pagination
options.body: Keep this issue open until Control UI can load older history pages on demand while keeping the initial payload bounded.

options.title: Accept fixed-batch mitigation
options.body: Treat the linked limit increase as an intentional pragmatic fix and close this issue only after that behavior lands on main with proof.

recommendation.title: Require pagination
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until Control UI can load older history pages on demand while keeping the initial payload bounded.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is product/UX shape across WebChat history and Gateway behavior, and steipete has the strongest repeated adjacent history in those areas.
